# state fixtures

- `basic.mmd`, `composite.mmd` and `concurrency.mmd` follow the examples in
  the Mermaid state diagram documentation
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/stateDiagram.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `legacy-sample.mmd` is the state sample shipped with mermaid-svg 0.7.0
  (`crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/state.mmd`), MIT licensed.
- `styled-cjk.mmd` is written for this crate: class styles, CJK and long
  labels, multi-line descriptions and notes.
